integrity: All findings are supported by an explicit character-sum proof and independent bounded direct enumeration; finite tests do not certify infinite claims; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled friendship graphs consisting of m>=1 triangles at a common vertex, standard strong odd vertex colouring, named palettes; not graph automorphism or palette quotient counts. Historical-priority comparisons may miss broader parity-incidence formulae.
title: Strong odd-coloring polynomial and parity gap for friendship graphs
